Container.Name: Sharesight-MCP
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: sharesight mcp model context protocol ai claude chatgpt llm portfolio shares stocks investing dividends tax holdings trades
Container.Overview:
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets AI assistants such as Claude read your Sharesight portfolio: portfolios, holdings, trades, payouts, performance and tax reports, cash accounts and more. Unofficial; uses the Sharesight v3 API.
:: BEFORE YOU START :: You need Sharesight API access. Request it from support@sharesight.com, then copy your Client ID and Client Secret from your Sharesight API application. API access may require a particular Sharesight plan.
:: QUICK START :: 1. Enter your Sharesight Client ID and Client Secret. 2. Set MCP Auth Token to a long random string (e.g. run: openssl rand -hex 32). The container will not start without it. Every MCP client must send it as: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN 3. Start the container. The MCP endpoint is http://SERVER:3000/mcp and a health check is at /healthz.
:: SAFE BY DEFAULT :: This template starts in READ-ONLY mode (25 read tools). Set Read-only mode to false only if you want the AI to be able to create, change or delete trades, payouts and other data in Sharesight.
:: SECURITY :: This server holds credentials to your financial data. Keep it on your LAN or VPN (e.g. Tailscale). If you publish it through a reverse proxy, put strong authentication in front of it and never share the auth token.
This is a community template. It is not affiliated with Sharesight or the sharesight-mcp authors. Please report template problems via the Support link.
Container.Requires: Sharesight API access (Client ID and Client Secret). Request it from support@sharesight.com.
Container.DonateText: I make the templates; you make the magic. If this was useful, shout me a coffee?

Config.Name: MCP port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the MCP endpoint (/mcp) and health check (/healthz). Change the host port if 3000 is already in use.

Config.Name: Sharesight Client ID
Config.Description: Client ID of your Sharesight API application.

Config.Name: Sharesight Client Secret
Config.Description: Client Secret of your Sharesight API application.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token
Config.Description: Required. A long random string (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32). Clients must send it as an 'Authorization: Bearer' header. The container will not start without it.

Config.Name: Read-only mode
Config.Description: true (default here) removes every tool that creates, changes or deletes Sharesight data. Set false to allow writes.

Config.Name: Cursor secret
Config.Description: Optional. Signs pagination cursors. If empty, a new random value is used on every start, so cursors stop working after a restart. Set any long random string to keep them valid.

Config.Name: Max response characters
Config.Description: Size limit for one page of a list, in characters (minimum 5000). Keep it under your AI client's tool-output limit.

Config.Name: Holdings cache (seconds)
Config.Description: How long the holdings list is cached for later pages. 0 turns the cache off.

Config.Name: Attachments folder
Config.Description: Optional. Host folder holding files (e.g. contract notes) the AI may attach to trades and payouts. Only used when Read-only mode is false and Attachments root is set to /attachments.

Config.Name: Attachments root
Config.Description: Optional. Set to /attachments to enable uploading attachments from the folder above. Leave empty if you do not use attachments (the server refuses to start if this points to a folder that does not exist).

Config.Name: Sharesight API base URL
Config.Description: Leave as is unless you are testing or using a proxy. Must be https.
